program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (21, 14, 24),          # input pair gm/Id (high -> bigger W, low flicker, low Vgs)
    "L1":    (4.0, 1.0, 6.0),       # input pair L (flicker ~ 1/(W L))
    "itail": (60e-6, 30e-6, 120e-6),
    "gmidp": (7, 5, 10),            # PMOS mirror + M6 gm/Id (matched)
    "Lp":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),
    "i2":    (220e-6, 100e-6, 350e-6),
    "gmidn": (12, 8, 15),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "fgbw":  (16e6, 11e6, 30e6),    # target UGBW, sets Cc
    "rzk":   (1.5, 1.0, 3.0),       # Rz = rzk / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it, i2 = p["itail"], p["i2"]
    i1 = it / 2

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.25)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=1.0)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i2, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], it, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], i2, vds=0.9)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["fgbw"])
    rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * cc + c1 * cl + cc * cl))
    cmir = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    pm_mirror = 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / pmir))   # pole-zero doublet ~ half
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * (rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)) if rz > 1.0 / m6.gm else 1e30
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) - pm_mirror + \
         math.degrees(math.atan(2 * PI * gbw / wz))

    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    sv_th = 2 * (8.0 / 3.0) * kT / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    # flicker calibrated to iter-1 sim: 285 nV @ gmid1=18, L1=1, itail=40u, gmidp=8, Lp=0.5
    # input part ~ 1/(W1 L1) ~ 1/(it * L1^2 * g(gmid)); mirror part ~ (gm3/gm1)^2/(W3 L3)
    ref = (285e-9) ** 2
    s_in = 0.7 * ref * (40e-6 / it) * (1.0 / p["L1"]) ** 2 * (18.0 / p["gmid1"]) ** 3
    s_mir = 0.3 * ref * (40e-6 / it) * (0.5 / p["Lp"]) ** 2 * ((p["gmidp"] / 8.0) ** 2) \
            * ((18.0 / p["gmid1"]) ** 2) * (p["gmidp"] / 8.0)
    noise = math.sqrt(sv_th + s_in + s_mir)
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i2)
    slew = min(it / cc, i2 / (cc + cl))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": noise, "slew": slew}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS output, Rz nulling)

1 kHz noise is flicker-dominated and the model ignored it (15x error). Enlarge the input pair (L1~4, gm/Id 21, more tail current) and use a long, low-gm/Id PMOS mirror; set Cc from a target UGBW; add
